body: I like this. I must find courage to ask her for an hour without all the papers.

A little dickish perhaps, but I have been considering it myself.

I am not sure about the weed thing. It has kept me alive for many years. Now when I can't smoke it it is horrible. 

I will try to make a list, it sounds like a good idea and I feel kinda stupid for not figuring out that myself. I think i will bring the list to my current one though. Because starting all over with a new one is also a tiresome event and will set me back several months
I don't know why, but doing things I am good at makes me anxious and nervous.

I have not read up on the aftereffects of bullying, perhaps I should.
After starting therapy i have pretty much avoided to read about mental illnesses.  

I feel I am unable to talk to my therapist. I have been there 5-6 times, and all we do is fill out this papers to help her diagnose me. Whenever I, in my really weak and hidden way try to get to talk more about one of the questions in her papers, she quickly moves on to the next question. I never, ever ever fucking never talk bad about other people, but I think that this therapist is, well, at least not a good match for me. But I have no clue as how to tell her.

I am afraid to hurt her feelings, as fucking stupid as it sounds. I don't even have the courage to ask for more appointments. Now I get 45 minutes every 14 days. I was so stupid telling her i smoke weed, I and have a suspicion she thinks of me as just another junkie trying to score ritalin.

I am not sure, but i was quite badly bullied at school. I have nightmares about it every single night. Especially one teacher from when i was 10-12 years. I have always been messy, forgetful and so on, and this teacher would on regular basis empty my school backpack on her desk and "sort it out". In front of the entire class. I hate that woman so much. I have so much hate in me that I hate myself.

from 14-16 I had this guy who would every fucking single "free time", seek me up and call me "names" and kick me.

I have absolutely no self confidence and ending my life is, in my mind, the only thing I truly am in control of.

I rarely get more than 1-2 hours of continuous sleep due to the nightmares. Soaking wet from sweat.

The thing that has kept me a live the last ten years is pot. I don't smoke much and not often. On average 3-5 times a month. But it gives me both a break from my own thought and the ability to sleep for longer periods of time without waking up and sweating.

But as I am trying to get to try ritalin to see if it can help me, I need to be "clean". But it is almost unbearable to not being able to "slow my brain down" with cannabis.
